accounting: public market-data recording; no order was sent; nothing here is realized profit

coverage.reading: A segment that starts mid-window legitimately shows a low max TTE for the market already in progress, so the gate asks for AT LEAST ONE market streamed from above coverage_min_tte_s. per_market_max_streamed_tte_s is published so a partially covered window can be excluded downstream instead of silently averaged in.

strike_resolved.note: window rows carry strike:null before availableAt; this is the re-read value

reading: down_leg_derived_present is the point of this recorder: the disqualifying BTC15M file had 23,318 UP rows and 0 DOWN rows, so no complement leg existed at all. A DOWN leg here is DERIVED from the raw UP ladder and labelled as such; down_probe records what the venue says about a separate DOWN instrument.

requirements.btc15m_window_seen: at least one BTC15M window listed
requirements.down_instrument_probed: a down_probe row: the venue was asked whether a separate -DOWN instrument exists
requirements.down_leg_derived_present: a pair_snapshot carrying a derived DOWN bid and ask -- the complement leg the disqualifying file never had
requirements.early_window_streamed: a STREAMED row (p_snapshot / p_depth / p_trade) at or above COVERAGE_MIN_TTE_S -- proof the opening portion of a window was received, not merely subscribed to
requirements.pair_cost_present: a pair_snapshot with a numeric two-leg pair cost
requirements.single_leg_spread_present: a pair_snapshot with a numeric single-leg spread, recorded separately from pair cost
requirements.subscribe_lead_verified: a SUBSCRIBE row whose recorded per-market tte_s reaches COVERAGE_MIN_TTE_S -- the lead actually in force, read off the tape, not assumed from a constant
requirements.trade_prints_present: at least one p_trade row (venue print tape)
requirements.up_book_two_sided: a pair_snapshot whose book_state is TWO_SIDED
requirements.up_ladder_has_sizes: a pair_snapshot with a priced level AND a size on both UP sides
requirements.venue_timestamps: a p_depth row carrying a venue E timestamp
requirements.window_poll_strike_resolved: a window_poll (or strike_resolved) row with a NON-NULL strike -- the authoritative strike that arrives after availableAt, not the null first listing
